description: This PHP class 'Sanitizer' in the 'OrangeHRM\Core\Utility' namespace provides a method 'sanitizeSvg' that sanitizes SVG content using an external SVG sanitizer library. It includes error handling via custom exception 'SanitizerException'.

classes.name: Sanitizer
classes.description: A utility class for sanitizing SVG content to ensure safety and integrity.

methods.name: sanitizeSvg
methods.description: Sanitizes provided SVG content string, returning either sanitized SVG or throwing an exception if bad formatting is detected.
